item_verdicts.diff: Read all seven commits (b452d0ed8..0132d0250) against 17b416ba3; they add the batch driver, fit, measure hook, render wrapper, summarizer, two probes, the fragment and two SVG figures with their window JSON, and the later commits correct an earlier correction-fraction read and add the probe evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when's quantitative measure is the two-arm table plus the per-conductor check; the worker records it in a fragment rather than a suite, and I re-read the receipts behind it (cohort/summary.json, probe-external.log, probe-applied.log) and the md5 identity of terminal.npz across the two arms rather than re-running the solve.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to measure how far the lower X-point moves when the fitted conductor-field mismatch is removed from the measured currents; scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/batch.py:11 runs both arms on all four rows and the record reports the movement as unmeasurable because the two terminal states are byte-identical.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the six commits, the titan job 1315558 and the rigel probe jobs 1315756 and 1315771, states the corrected arms are identical to the measured ones, reports the published-fit disagreement under outside_scope, and leaves tests empty with the reason that no test reaches the change.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the manifest's declared paths and the commit-by-commit diff: all thirteen changed paths sit inside scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/, docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-xpoint-coil-correction.html and docs/figures/diiid-xpoint-coil-correction/.

justifications.durability: The diff adds no test, and its single assertion, scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/measure.py:83, guards only that the benchmark module resolved inside the tree, so nothing reddens if the fit, the correction install or the summarizer regresses.
justifications.evidence: Every reported number reconciles with the run receipts: cohort/summary.json reproduces 137D 2.360 cm, residual 137D 1.139e-12 and F1A +54.06 kA-turn, and cohort/probe-external.log and cohort/probe-applied.log carry the 6.063/1.677 and 0.397 Wb readings the record quotes.
justifications.fit: The scripts follow the neighbouring diiid_xpoint_* drivers and the naming checks are clean, but scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/measure.py:44 is 90 characters against pyproject.toml:201's line-length of 88 and is the only lint finding among the added scripts.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The eight-arm table at docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-xpoint-coil-correction.html:28 carries residual, convergence, termination, in-plasma extrema, support, both lower-X offset components and the share for all four rows on both arms, and the record states the movement as unmeasured rather than zero.
justifications.reuse: measure.py, fit.py and render.py wrap existing owners (diiid_xpoint_held_nodes/measure.py, diiid_xpoint_attribution/attribute.py, diiid_xpoint_profile_extent/render.py), but scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/batch.py:20-103 duplicates the cohort runner owned by scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_profile_extent/batch.py:27-160 instead of importing it.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the commit-by-commit diff sits under the three declared write paths (scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_coil_correction/, the fragment and docs/figures/diiid-xpoint-coil-correction/), and no nova/ or tests/ file changed.
